meta.description: A passage-completion experiment crossing the type of a relative clause on the direct object of an object-biased implicit-causality verb (one inviting the inference of a cause of the matrix event or not) with the prompt (a pronoun or nothing). The free-prompt continuations estimate the next-mention prior and the production rates, the pronoun-prompt continuations the interpretation bias. Table 4 compares the observed rate of pronominal reference to the object with the rates predicted by the Bayesian, Mirror and Expectancy models, and the fits of the three models over participant and item means. The PDF read is the accepted manuscript, whose pagination differs from the journal's. The rates are printed without the leading zero.
